findings.issue: H3709 feminine plural remains open among palm, pan, and spoon; «cucharas» narrows it to spoons.
אֲשֶׁר … בָּהֵן is a relative plus ב with a 3fp resumptive (in/with them); «con que» smooths that into an instrumental relative.

notes: Number, person, qal «hizo», hophal «se derrama», suffixes, article, and final «oro puro» stay inside the tokens.
